Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you
were involved in while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. Is it all right if I record our conversation?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please state your full name and the best number to raech you.
A: I'd rather keep my personal details off the recording for now, but you can reach me through the claim file.
Q: That works. Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the impact?
A: I was in the right lane on a multi-lane road, going about the speed of traffic. I checked my mirror, signaled, and
started moving left into the middle lane because I needed to get over for an upcoming turn.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?
A: I looked, but it was in my blind spot. I didn't see it until the moment it pulled alongside me. The other driver's side
mirror brushed my front quarter panel and then my rear door.
Q: Did either vehicle stop after contact?
A: We both pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver got out, we exchanged information, and then I drove to a
parking lot nearby.
Q: How are you feeling physically since the collision?
A: My neck is stiff and sore, and the pain runs into my upper back. Turning my head to check traffic hurts. I started
having headaches the next morning.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment for those symptoms?
A: Yes, I was evaluated at an urgent care clinic the same afternoon, and I'm now seeing a physical therapist twice a
week.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add before we conclude?
A: No, I think that covers it.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
